original_test_intent: Validate the Error Granularity enumeration for each applicable SMBIOS Type 18 record, showing the reported scope of a memory error and whether that diagnostic scope remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw and decoded Type 18 records with related Type 16/17/33 context, retain each handle and numeric granularity enum, interpret record freshness and scope under approved policy, and compare the same records after reboot without fault injection.
manual_activity: A user defines accepted granularity states and approves reboot; no DIMM handling, injected error or human visual judgment is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Error Granularity enum mapping
Expected granularity/no-record/stale-record policy for the platform
Type 16/17/18/33 relationship rules and raw-capable parser
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection and never inject a memory error to force a granularity value.
Do not clear error history or change ECC/memory configuration.
Preserve raw enum, record handle and companion fields before normalization.
Treat granularity as diagnostic scope rather than present fault severity; stop on invalid enums, ambiguous freshness or reboot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode and validate each granularity enum, correlate its Type 18 record and companion context, and compare complete pre/post reboot evidence.
Flag invalid, stale, absent or unexpectedly changed scopes without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected granularity and lifecycle semantics plus reboot/recovery plan.
Interpret diagnostic history in project context and issue the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot bind granularity to a Type 18 handle, numeric enum, Error Type/Operation or address record.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 16/17/18/33 records and report per Type 18 handle the raw/normalized granularity, companion error fields, links, freshness and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 18 granularity scope, linked script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no error stimulus is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Version-decode every Type 18 Error Granularity field, preserve raw enum and handle, correlate companion record fields and inventory/error context, then compare after reboot under the approved freshness policy.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS implementations exposing Type 18 memory-error records.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and error-subsystem versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 18 Error Granularity definitions and project diagnostic-lifecycle policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum, handle identity, companion-field correlation and freshness-aware reboot comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Distinguishes device-, partition- and unknown-scope records and catches invalid or misassociated values that label grep misses.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A reported granularity is firmware diagnostic metadata; without an approved separate injection test this case does not validate fault generation or containment.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept different granularity values for different recorded error classes, but must define the mapping; lack of a Type 18 record must be handled explicitly rather than passed by an empty grep.
expected_evidence: Approved enum/scope, no-record and freshness policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17/18/33 evidence with versions and handles
Per-record raw/normalized Error Granularity and correlated Error Type/Operation/address context
Read-only OS/BMC error context without injected faults or cleared history
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Error Granularity is a valid Type 18 field; platform-specific expected scope is a readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core enum, relationship and persistence checks are software-automatable after inputs and reboot approval.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, record handle, companion-field relationships and lifecycle semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its diagnostic and no-fault safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automatable collection from owner policy and formal verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic decoded string from passing without proving which error record and diagnostic scope it describes.
independent_technical_reasoning: Granularity is an enumerated Type 18 field whose schema validation, record correlation and reboot diff are deterministic; owner inputs do not make the core manual.
